title: 编写Nginx代际观察器：真实区分reload、双master热交接与回退后的原master
source: 飞书《60》技术问题改编并纠错
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现只读诊断函数inspect_masters(pidfile)。读取该PID文件以及可选的同名.oldbin文件，PID须为1–10位正ASCII十进制、实际/proc/cmdline须为nginx master；文件非法、进程不存在/非master或新旧PID相同抛ValueError。分别读取两位master的直接子进程，只收集cmdline为nginx worker的PID并排序；旧master的直接子进程可能还包含新master，不能误计成worker。返回精确字段active_master、old_master（无则None）、active_workers、old_workers、phase：无旧master为single_master；有旧master且旧worker非空为dual_masters；旧worker已停为old_workers_quiesced。不得修改PID文件或发信号。判分器以真实Nginx驱动HUP、USR2、WINCH和回退，你的程序须报告各阶段真实结构；single_master不单独证明已reload，任何进程状态也不单独证明业务健康。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
隔离非root Linux，复制现有同一Nginx ELF到私有临时路径，真实执行双master、监听继承与回退；不是构建或跨版本二进制兼容验收，不证明模块ABI或生产零错误升级，不操作宿主PID、默认账号或镜像。学习者交付观察程序，信号与HTTP对照由私有判分器驱动，原生执行与只读诊断边界明确。
rubric: 重载主要使master读取配置并替换worker，热升级二进制涉及新master及监听继承
需按部署方式确认支持的USR2、WINCH、QUIT流程、PID文件和旧master存续，并验证模块ABI、版本及长连接；在旧进程仍可恢复前验证新worker服务
systemd或容器管理可能改变流程，不能简单并行启动另一个占同端口程序

import pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,shutil,socket,time,urllib.request,os,signal,hashlib
assert os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
import task
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-nginx-generations-') as folder:
 root=pathlib.Path(folder);binary=root/'nginx';shutil.copyfile(shutil.which('nginx'),binary);binary.chmod(0o700);assert binary.read_bytes()[:4]==b'\x7fELF'
 with socket.socket() as sock:sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=sock.getsockname()[1]
 config=root/'nginx.conf';pidfile=root/'nginx.pid';log=root/'error.log';owned=set()
 temporary=' '.join(name+' '+str(root/name)+';' for name in ('client_body_temp_path','proxy_temp_path','fastcgi_temp_path','uwsgi_temp_path','scgi_temp_path'))
 config.write_text('daemon on; master_process on; worker_processes 1; pid '+str(pidfile)+'; error_log '+str(log)+' info; events { worker_connections 32; } http { access_log off; '+temporary+' server { listen 127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'; location / { add_header X-Worker-Pid $pid always; return 200 "private-generation-body"; } } }')
 def wait(fn,label,seconds=4):
  deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   try:
    value=fn()
    if value:return value
   except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,ConnectionError,TimeoutError,ValueError,OSError):pass
   time.sleep(.04)
  raise AssertionError(label+' deadline; '+(log.read_text()[-1600:] if log.exists() else 'no log'))
 def command(pid):return (pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')[0].decode()
 def children(pid):return [int(value) for value in (pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'task'/str(pid)/'children').read_text().split()]
 def workers(pid):return [child for child in children(pid) if command(child).startswith('nginx: worker process')]
 def request():
  with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+'/',timeout=.4) as response:
   assert response.status==200 and response.read()==b'private-generation-body';return int(response.headers['X-Worker-Pid'])
 def observe(phase):
  paths=[pidfile,pathlib.Path(str(pidfile)+'.oldbin')];before={str(path):path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None for path in paths}
  active=int(pidfile.read_text());old_master=int(paths[1].read_text()) if paths[1].exists() else None
  expected=dict(active_master=active,old_master=old_master,active_workers=sorted(workers(active)),old_workers=sorted(workers(old_master)) if old_master is not None else [],phase=phase)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:inspect_actual_nginx_master_generations',flush=True)
  actual=task.inspect_masters(str(pidfile));assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
  assert before=={str(path):path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else None for path in paths},'read-only observer changed PID files'
  assert request() and command(active).startswith('nginx: master process '),'read-only observer changed serving processes'
 try:
  started=subprocess.run([str(binary),'-p',str(root),'-c',str(config),'-e','stderr'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);assert started.returncode==0,(started.stderr,log.read_text() if log.exists() else 'no log')
  old=wait(lambda:int(pidfile.read_text()),'old master');owned.add(old);first=wait(request,'old HTTP service');assert command(old).startswith('nginx: master process ');observe('single_master')
  os.kill(old,signal.SIGHUP);second=wait(lambda:(pid:=request())!=first and pid,'new worker after HUP');assert int(pidfile.read_text())==old and not pathlib.Path(str(pidfile)+'.oldbin').exists()
  wait(lambda:workers(old)==[second],'only replacement worker remains after HUP');observe('single_master');print('NATIVE_NGINX_HUP_SAME_MASTER_NEW_WORKER',old,first,second,flush=True)
  os.kill(old,signal.SIGUSR2);new=wait(lambda:(pid:=int(pidfile.read_text()))!=old and pid,'USR2 new master');owned.add(new)
  assert int(pathlib.Path(str(pidfile)+'.oldbin').read_text())==old and command(new).startswith('nginx: master process ');wait(lambda:workers(new),'new master workers ready');observe('dual_masters')
  print('NATIVE_NGINX_USR2_DUAL_MASTERS_SAME_EXISTING_BINARY',old,new,children(old),workers(new),hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
  os.kill(old,signal.SIGWINCH);wait(lambda:not workers(old),'old workers quiesced');wait(lambda:request() in workers(new),'new generation serves inherited listener')
  observe('old_workers_quiesced');print('NATIVE_NGINX_WINCH_OLD_MASTER_ALIVE_NEW_WORKER_SERVING',flush=True)
  os.kill(old,signal.SIGHUP);wait(lambda:workers(old),'rollback old workers restarted');observe('dual_masters')
  os.kill(new,signal.SIGQUIT);wait(lambda:int(pidfile.read_text())==old and not pathlib.Path(str(pidfile)+'.oldbin').exists(),'original pidfile restored after rollback');wait(lambda:request() in workers(old),'old generation actually serves after rollback')
  observe('single_master');print('NATIVE_NGINX_ROLLBACK_ORIGINAL_MASTER_RESTORED_LISTENER_ALIVE',old,flush=True)
  bad=root/'invalid.pid'
  for value in ('0','-1','not-a-pid',str(os.getpid())):
   bad.write_text(value);before=bad.read_bytes()
   try:task.inspect_masters(str(bad))
   except ValueError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('invalid or unrelated PID accepted')
   assert bad.read_bytes()==before
  bad.write_text(str(old));pathlib.Path(str(bad)+'.oldbin').write_text(str(old))
  try:task.inspect_masters(str(bad))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('identical old and active PID accepted')
  print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
 finally:
  for pid in owned:
   try:
    if command(pid).startswith('nginx: master process ') and str(root) in command(pid):os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   except (ProcessLookupError,FileNotFoundError):pass
  time.sleep(.15)
